concerns.text: SC-002 (statistical significance of the MMN amplitude difference < 0.05) is not explicitly verified by any task. Existing tasks generate statistics.json but no task asserts that the corrected p‑value meets the < 0.05 threshold.

SC-005 (≥80 % of valid participants must have peak latency within 150–250 ms, or fallback 100–300 ms) is not covered by any task. While T023–T025 perform peak detection and T029–T035 produce latency_validation.json, no task checks the 80 % prevalence condition or reports pass/fail.
